name: sugarcraft/sugar-crush
description: Chat-shell TUI for AI coding assistants — port of charmbracelet/crush. Pluggable Backend interface (ship your own Anthropic / OpenAI / Ollama / shell-out adapter). Markdown rendering of replies via CandyShine, scrollback viewport via SugarBits, input area via SugarBits TextArea.

suggest.ext-curl: Used by the HTTP-based providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, SGLang, Custom).

deferred-wiring.sugarcraft/candy-kit: E453. NOT a stale require and NOT spent: added by commit ddd9560d0 for one named, still-open item - restyling Cli\Help::screen() with candy-kit's Banner/Section/HelpText. It is unwired because the restyle was costed and deferred, not because nobody remembers why: candy-kit's primitives emit ANSI unconditionally and --help is routinely piped, so a faithful restyle needs a posix_isatty() guard the item never specified, against the single `<<<'HELP'` heredoc that IS that method's body (no line count here on purpose - it moves, and the symbol does not) and a HelpTest that asserts line-start regexes any SGR prefix breaks. tools/check-path-repos.php --unused reports it as PRUNE_REQUIRE_AND_REPO and that report is a CANDIDATE by the tool's own words; this row is the by-hand confirmation it asks for, in the direction of keeping the dependency. Delete this row when the wiring lands - never to quiet the check.
